data: In fiscal 2025, the year ended January 26, 2025, NVIDIA reported revenue of $130,497 million, gross profit of $97,858 million and operating income of $81,453 million, according to its Form 10-K filed February 26, 2025. That gives a gross margin of about 75.0% and an operating margin of about 62.4%. Both margins were up from fiscal 2024, when revenue of $60,922 million produced a gross margin of about 72.7% and an operating margin of about 54.1%. Revenue rose roughly 114% year over year, while total operating expenses increased only to $16,405 million from $11,329 million, so operating margin expanded sharply.
